summary: V2 Citizen Constituency Transfer Workflow — end-to-end verification. Backend: 14/14 unit tests (test_m3_transfer.py) PASS + 12/13 new HTTP-layer E2E tests (test_m3_transfer_e2e.py, 1 skipped due to test-harness limitation, not a backend bug) PASS against the live preview backend. All flows confirmed working: (1) /api/auth/citizen/check-mobile returns the correct payload for unknown/same-tenant/cross-tenant cases; (2) /api/auth/citizen/register at Tenant B with a mobile registered at Tenant A returns HTTP 409 with detail.code='TRANSFER_REQUIRED' and the full detection payload; (3) /api/auth/citizen/transfer/initiate creates a TransferRequest with demo_otp='123456' and a future expires_at; (4) /api/auth/citizen/transfer/verify performs the atomic transfer — archives the old Membership with archive_reason='transferred' and cross-links to new mid, creates the new Membership in Tenant B with transferred_from_membership_id, updates Person.current_organisation_id/current_membership_id, marks old V1 user is_active=false with _transferred_out_to_user_id, creates new V1 user in Tenant B sharing the same person_id, freshly creates the household, mobile credential stays active and tied to the same Person id; (5) audits (person_audit, membership_audit, person_timeline_events) emit all required events; (6) /api/auth/citizen/verify-otp at the OLD tenant after transfer correctly returns {transferred_out:true, current_portal:{slug:'pune-cantonment',...}, message} with NO token; (7) /api/me/transfer-info at the NEW tenant returns {transferred_in:true, transferred_from:{organisation, reason, archived_at}, history:[archived, active]}; (8) idempotency on /transfer/verify replay confirmed (same user/household/membership IDs returned, no duplicate active memberships, no duplicate Person); (9) invalid OTP → 400 'Invalid OTP', expired TransferRequest → 400 'expired'; (10) family relationships_v2 rows survive transfer (person-id linked, status still active); (11) /api/admin/v2/parity returns ok=true post-transfer. Frontend: TransferConfirmDialog and TransferOtpDialog dialogs verified visible in the live preview flow with the correct from/to constituency names ('Kopargaon' → 'Pune Cantonment') and the demo OTP hint. The final OTP submit → /app navigation step in the automated browser run timed out at 30s; backend HTTP E2E confirms the same code path works correctly end-to-end (token + user issued, history shows archived+active, transferred_out blocks old-tenant login).

integration_issues.flow: CitizenRegister page — direct URL load via /citizen/register?portal=<slug> (no React Router state)
integration_issues.issue: The page reads tenant_slug from loc.state only (loc.state?.tenant_slug). When opened directly via the URL query parameter, tenantSlug stays null and the form submit hits POST /auth/citizen/register without tenant_slug → server returns 400 'Portal context required'. The expected UX (coming from /citizen/login?portal=<slug> after new_user=true) does set state correctly, so this is a deep-link UX gap rather than a regression. Consider also parsing tenant_slug from the query string as a fallback.

integration_issues.flow: CitizenRegister — useEffect calling api.get('/areas') without a token throws a 401
integration_issues.issue: Page mount fires api.get('/areas') which requires staff auth → 401. In dev mode this surfaces as a React error overlay covering the page and blocks interaction unless dismissed. The promise rejection is unhandled — wrap in a try/catch or guard the call when no token is present.

action_items: (Low priority) Make CitizenRegister.jsx also read tenant_slug from the URL query string as a fallback to loc.state, so the page is robust to direct navigation / page reloads.

(Low priority) Wrap the api.get('/areas') call inside CitizenRegister's useEffect in try/catch (or short-circuit when no auth token) to avoid the React error overlay covering the page when 401s occur.
(Optional) Expose the V1 user id of the archived membership in /api/me/transfer-info history items so staff-side banner verification can chain off the citizen self-view in tests.
critical_code_review_comments: v2_transfer.py verify_and_execute_transfer is idempotent (confirmed): replay returns the same user/household/membership ids and active-membership count stays at 1.
server.py citizen_register (~672-691): 409 + detail.code='TRANSFER_REQUIRED' wrapping is correct and matches the frontend's catch handler in CitizenRegister.jsx.

server.py verify_otp (~544-576): properly excludes is_active=False rows from the lookup and falls back to surfacing the transferred_out hint with the new portal's slug — no token returned. Verified end-to-end.

server.py me_transfer_info (~629-669): returns the full membership history for the citizen self-view, which is the right scope (citizen sees their own cross-tenant history). Staff queries remain tenant-scoped.
Mobile credential uniqueness preserved: the cred_type_value_active_unique index keeps exactly one active credential per (type,value) and the transfer correctly leaves it bound to the same Person id.

Family relationships are person-id linked (relationships_v2.from_person_id / to_person_id) → transfer of either side does NOT touch relationships_v2. Confirmed by test_family_relationships_survive_transfer.

rca of the issue: No backend bug RCA needed — all transfer assertions passed end-to-end against the live backend. Two minor UX gaps in CitizenRegister.jsx surfaced during browser automation (loc.state-only tenant_slug parsing + unhandled 401 from /areas on page mount) — both are non-blocking for the intended login→register flow but worth tightening for direct-URL robustness.
